published_source: Printed Table 7, column (1) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2022.4326.pdf), read Nov 4 2026; equals the authors' code output to the printed decimals. The article numbers its tables differently from the code: the code's Table 6 is the printed Table 7 (Directorships of Regulators and F-Score); the printed Table 4 is summary statistics. The spec's table field keeps the code numbering. Earlier: Not from the article (no article text in the project). Authors' 'code final.do' Tables 4-6 block re-run in Stata MP 16.1 (reghdfe 5.7.3) on the shipped samplems.dta (work copy ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2022.4326/stata/t4_t6.do, log t4_t6.log); fixest reproduces it to 7 digits. Column numbers inferred from code order (no-controls column first).
table_note: published article numbering (Nov 4 2026); the authors' code and log number this table 6, which earlier records used
replication_status: exact (authors' code output 0.0444558 (0.0254234), N 6901, equals printed Table 7, column (1) 0.044 (0.025), N 6,901, to the printed decimals; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
notes: Table 6 column (1): reghdfe highriskf1 treatboardtena if insnnn==1, absorb(i.fyear##i.sic2 i.gvkey) cluster(gvkey) ('code final.do' Tables 4-6 block, lines 469-491). Outcome: F-score > 1 (0/1). Treatment: any FREP senior executive (Head of Enforcement, FREP board member or Nomination Committee member) on the firm's board during FREP tenure; hand-coded by gvkey and fiscal year in 'code final.do' lines 137-387. Sample insnnn = e(sample) of the authors' with-controls regression (fyear > 2003, non-missing treatment and lagged controls, singletons dropped): German listed non-financial firms 2004-2019, 697 firms. FE: firm + two-digit-SIC-by-year (xt_vars = sic2 gives id + t + t^sic2, which spans reghdfe's fyear + sic2 + fyear#sic2). sic2 comes from historical SIC (sich) and varies over time for 71 of 697 firms, so the industry-by-year FE are not strictly a time-invariant characteristic x time; TWFE/BJS use the row-level sic2 exactly as the authors do. 28 treated firms (145 treated firm-years), 669 never-treated firms (96.3% of rows). First-treated years (firms; always-treated in parentheses): 2004:10(10), 2005:2, 2007:3(1), 2008:2, 2010:1, 2011:1, 2012:3, 2013:1, 2014:2(1), 2017:1(1), 2018:2(1). Cohorts with pre- and post-treatment rows: 2005, 2007, 2008, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2018. Switch-offs in the regression sample: 31 firm-years with treatboardtena = 0 after first treatment (KUKA 2010-2019 except 2017-2018, Terex 2011-2012, Loewe 2007-2012, Schloss Wachenheim 2011-2019, Diebold Nixdorf 2017-2018, Deutsche Post 2011-2014). These are coded 0 (not missing) in the authors' code because treatboardtena is generated from treatheadten == 1 with all other values set to 0, and Deutsche Post 2011-2017 is coded 0 explicitly. run_spec.R drops them (Hull fn 6), so the run_spec TWFE (x outcome SD) equals the fixest TWFE on the protocol sample (twfe_raw_protocol_sample), not the authors' coefficient. The adjacent with-controls column (laglogat lagroa leverage lagmtb ma big4, winsorized) is not eligible.
